description: Favicons, app icons and a web manifest from one logo, like the site’s Icon Pack: favicon.ico (16, 32 and 48 px), favicon-16x16.png, favicon-32x32.png, favicon.svg (from an SVG logo), apple-touch-icon.png (180 px), icon-192.png, icon-512.png, icon-512-maskable.png (logo kept inside Android’s safe zone), site.webmanifest and snippet.html with the <head> tags. Saved in a new folder (icon-pack) in ~/Downloads/one-design. Best from an SVG or a PNG of 512 px or more.

adaptive.description: SVG logos only: favicon.svg changes colour to stay visible on light and dark browser tabs.

app_name.description: Name for the web manifest (“My site” if left empty).

custom_colour.description: Logo colour when logo_colour is "custom", hex like #c9f26b.

dark_colour.description: Logo colour on dark tabs (adaptive), hex like #ffffff.

favicon_background.description: Behind the tab favicons: "fill" a rounded square in the icon background, "none", or "auto" (a square only for a light logo, which would vanish on light tabs).

light_colour.description: Logo colour on light tabs (adaptive), hex like #111111.

logo.description: The logo file: SVG or PNG (512 px or larger), JPEG or WebP.

logo_colour.description: The logo’s colour in every icon: as it is, or recoloured.

maskable.description: Include icon-512-maskable.png: Android crops icons to circles or squircles, this keeps the logo inside the safe zone.

padding.description: Space around the logo on the app icons, as a % of the icon.

short_name.description: Short name under a home screen icon. Default: the name.

name: make_icon_pack
title: Make an icon pack
